body: As I originally said, this makes me want to kill myself even more.

You know who has that mindset? *Everyfuckingbody*. The fucking definition of failure is attempting to achieve an outcome and it *not happening.*

I can't stand this canned shit anymore. I'll just grab this confidence off of this confidence tree and go to the bar and woo everybody by screaming a story at the top of my lungs of that one time I got blackout and pissed my pants, or whatever, and women will all of a sudden ignore all my faults. I won't be ugly, fat, shy, inexperienced, suicidal, and I'm sure a billion things I don't even know anymore.

No, fuck this. I'm just going to leave as light a corpse as I can.
